definitions.explanation: Describes something impressively bright, distinguished, or praiseworthy. Used for achievements, records, futures, and other things worthy of admiration.

examples.japanese: {輝|かがや}かしい{未来|みらい}が{待|ま}っている。
{彼|かれ}には{輝|かがや}かしい{経歴|けいれき}がある。
このチームは{過去|かこ}に{輝|かがや}かしい{成績|せいせき}を{残|のこ}してきた。
examples.english: This team has left behind a brilliant track record.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal and laudatory adjective derived from the verb {輝|かがや}く (to shine). Commonly used in speeches, news, and formal writing to praise achievements, careers, or promising futures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輝|かがや}かしい{実績|じっせき} (brilliant achievements)
- {輝|かがや}かしい{未来|みらい} (a radiant future)
- {輝|かがや}かしい{経歴|けいれき} (a distinguished career)
- {輝|かがや}かしい{歴史|れきし} (a glorious history)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {華|はな}やか: gorgeous, glamorous (visual or social brilliance)
- {素晴|すば}らしい: wonderful, splendid (broader, more everyday)
